text:
elena: Hey team — kicking off onboarding for model 'zeta-13B-v1' (open variant). Need a precision+calibration plan (int8 / fp8 / gguf) and a short bring-up checklist. Goal: ~2x cost reduction vs fp32 while keeping <1.5% absolute drop on our LLM-eval suite. Who can lead the calibration runs and the eval harness?
samir: I can own experiments and orchestration. Proposed phases: 1) baseline fp32 runs (perf + eval), 2) PTQ int8 sweep, 3) fp8 ablation, 4) gguf packaging + verify. Need dataset pointers and target metrics.
matt: Quick checklist idea: - baseline perf/latency (p50/p95) - unit-cost estimate - automated eval set (MMLU, HellaSwag, our 50-customer prompts) - safety/sanity prompts - KV-cache consistency check - decode-sampling divergence tests
jiayi: For calibration specifics: - calibration corpus: 10k–25k tokens sampled from training-like distribution (recommend 10k min) - methods to try: per-channel-symmetric + min-max-clipping + l2-clipping - grid of scale factors: [0.5,0.8,1.0,1.2] - measure: perplexity, logit KL w.r.t. fp32, and token-level accuracy on seed prompts - include a short prompt-length sweep (1/64/256 tokens) for attention kernel behavior
ops-bot: FYI: eng-infra can provision an isolated dedicated pool for this (dev-squad). To request, post in #eng-infra with quota tag.
kyle: Example calibration config to run (small snippet):
```
calibration: 
  method: l2-clipping
  corpus: s3://redwood-calib/zeta13b/calib_10k.jsonl
  batch_size: 16
  clip_scales: [0.5,0.8,1.0,1.2]
  kv_check: true

eval: 
  suites: [mmlu, hellaswag, redwood-cust50]
  metrics: [accuracy, perplexity, rouge_l, human_pref]
  seeds: [42,7,99]
```
anita: Operational constraint: set an early-warning threshold to stop the run: any top-line metric drop >1.25% vs fp32 should pause rollout and require manual sign-off. For human_pref we need min 200 pairwise judgments to consider a difference significant.
samir: Timeline proposal: smoke runs in 48h (quick int8 with 1 scale), then full sweep across scales in 3 business days, full eval + human prefs in 5 business days. I'll create an airtable and assign owners. @elena can you confirm infra cost cap?
elena: Confirmed cost cap $2,000 for the experiment budget. Prioritize runs by expected quality/cost slope — start with int8 PTQ + minimal calibration, then fp8 if int8 fails to meet SLOs. Upload calibration corpus links to the shared drive and tag me. Thanks! :thumbsup:
